goal: Improve real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 MoE performance versus flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

probe_task08_gemm2_runtime.py: Added diagnostic-only GEMM2 symbols behind include_diag_symbols so default clean postsync extension is not polluted.
Added a separate gemm2_diag work root and _diag extension tag for diagnostic GEMM2 variants.
Added tile-grid split-column warp-shuffle diagnostic wrappers, including a new post-load-sync plus post-epilogue-sync variant.
probe_task08_gemm2_diff.py: New chunked full-output GEMM2 diff probe. It compares clean reference and diagnostic candidate outputs without materializing a full fp32 diff.
Reports bad row_flat, local_expert, row_in_expert, column, column groups, and candidate-vs-candidate stability.
Can run candidate first to expose order-sensitive bugs.
probe_task08_end_to_end.py: Added diagnostic flags for sync-before-final-scatter, clone-gemm2-before-final-scatter, and pre-scatter GEMM2 abs capture.

important_findings.finding: metadata_valid_slots SwiGLU path currently produced corrupted GEMM2 inputs in fresh correctness runs, while legacy_count_dense SwiGLU was correct.
important_findings.action: Use legacy_count_dense for GEMM2 epilogue diagnostics until metadata SwiGLU instability is isolated.

important_findings.finding: warp-shuffle post-load-sync without post-epilogue sync can match clean postsync exactly when isolated, but fails intermittently in end-to-end runs.
important_findings.conclusion: The no-post-epilogue-sync variant is still not safe to promote. A full pre-scatter read can mask the issue, so sample/full GEMM2-only diff is not sufficient proof for this variant.

important_findings.finding: Adding post-epilogue sync to the warp-shuffle post-load-sync variant restored short-run end-to-end correctness under legacy SwiGLU while preserving the GEMM2 speed gain.
important_findings.conclusion: Useful GEMM2 progress, but still far from beating FlashInfer end to end.

current_status.correctness: PASS in repeated skip-bench correctness and one short benchmark process
current_status.overall_gap: Candidate total remains about 2.75 ms versus FlashInfer about 1.39 ms.
current_status.default_path: Not changed to the diagnostic variant. Keep diagnostic symbols explicit until more repeated E2E runs and the metadata SwiGLU instability are resolved.

recommended_next_steps: Localize why metadata_valid_slots SwiGLU can produce corrupted GEMM2/out while legacy_count_dense passes.
Run more repeated E2E correctness for atrex_gemm2_tilegrid_splitcolepi_warpshuffle_postldsync_postsync under legacy SwiGLU before promotion.
If stable, make the post-epilogue-sync warp-shuffle variant the selected GEMM2 candidate for further experiments.
Large remaining gains still require reducing GEMM1/SwiGLU/final-scatter memory traffic or fusing GEMM2 with final scatter.
